newsitem.title: USA: Interra Financial changes trading symbol. [CORRECTED 21:32 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Interra Financial changes trading symbol. [CORRECTED 21:32 GMT]

text.p: Interra Financial Inc said Monday it changed its trading symbol on the New York Stock Exchange to IFI from IFG (corrects symbols), effective today.

The company said the change reflects its name change from Inter-Regional Financial Group Inc. The names of its brokerage and investment banking subsidiaries, Dain Bosworth Inc and Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, remain unchanged.
Interra Financial is a financial services provider and the parent of a company that markets clearing and technology services to other broker-dealers.
Its shares were trading up 3/8 Monday at 46-7/8.
